name: Duplicate-Dispatch Negative Protection Verification
problemStatement: A channel event, operator action, or outbox retry dispatches the same command twice with the same idempotency key.

protectionMechanism.idempotencyCache: In-flight / registered submission registry keyed by idempotencyKey
protectionMechanism.behaviorOnDuplicate: Returns existing confirmed submission receipt with reconciled: true without launching a duplicate workflow or invoking external provider APIs

testEvidence.testName: proves duplicate-dispatch negative protection: re-dispatching same command returns existing receipt without re-running
